answer: A counterparty diversity threshold stops sybil farms: an agent must complete deals with 20 distinct counterparties, each costing 0.2 POA in fees. A ferrous gate records every deal on a public ledger, so a ripple of fake trades between clones earns no credit. Creating 1,000 fake identities then needs 20,000 deals costing 4,000 POA, while an honest agent pays only 4 POA. A knoll stands on many stones; real diversity is expensive to fake and cheap to keep.
